why.note: Interest rate hikes cause catastrophic price drops if portfolio duration is unhedged

what.note: Macaulay duration divided by one plus yield per period measuring percentage price sensitivity

how.note: Multiplying minus modified duration by yield shift Delta y directly estimates proportional bond price change

limitations.note: First-order linear duration underestimates bond price gains and overstates drops without convexity

misconception.myth: Modified duration gives an exact prediction of bond price changes for any interest rate movement.
misconception.reality: Modified duration is only a first-order linear approximation; large interest rate shifts require adding positive convexity curvature.

predictionQuestions.question: If market interest rates rise by 50 basis points on a bond with a 5.0 year modified duration, will the bond price rise or fall, and by how much?

causalChain.condition: Orange County held a leveraged 20 billion dollar repo portfolio with a high duration of 7.4 years.
causalChain.action: The Federal Reserve aggressively increased benchmark interest rates by 300 basis points in 1994.
causalChain.mechanism: The long 7.4 year duration multiplied the interest rate increase into massive capital losses on bond collateral.
causalChain.result: The leveraged investment pool suffered a devastating 1.6 billion dollar cash loss.
causalChain.consequence: Orange County declared municipal bankruptcy, demonstrating the fatal danger of unhedged duration risk.
